summary: Comprehensive testing of Asistencia/Time-tracking module (Sesame HR-inspired). Backend: all 24 pytest tests pass (auth, schedules CRUD with auto-totals, employee schedule assignment, full clock-in/pause/resume/clock-out flow with pause-time exclusion, records, summary, devices singleton, admin-only protection). Frontend: sidebar item Asistencia visible, /asistencia loads correctly, config page shows all 6 tabs, 'Añadir jornada' modal with Horario fijo/flexible works, Dispositivos tab shows 3 cards (Panel web active, Celular + Kiosco PRÓXIMAMENTE) + Registro Biométrico, perfil empleado /perfil/1 tab Horarios shows monthly calendar with Mes/Semana summary and 'Asignar horario' button for admin.

critical_code_review_comments: asistencia.py is 489 lines; if features grow, consider splitting (schedules / attendance / devices) into separate routers under routes/asistencia/.
Authorization in /attendance/records and /attendance/summary correctly enforces admin-only cross-employee access. Consider using a dedicated dependency to DRY up.
GET /asistencia/devices doesn't await admin (correctly: any user can read). PUT correctly requires admin.
DEVICES_DOC_ID is a hardcoded 'singleton' string – fine for single-tenant. If multi-tenant added, will need org_id key.
_seconds_worked uses server clock; if backend clock drifts, durations could be off – not a blocker.
Frontend modal 'Crear nueva jornada' renders inline editor on selecting an option; works but the modal stays mounted – minor UX. Not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_-prefixed schedules. After test run an existing 'Normal' schedule from prior smoke test remains and an active assignment was recreated for employee 1 (maria).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asistencia module is fully working end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_asistencia.py covers all flows. The persistent chronometer is implemented as backend-computed seconds_elapsed served via /attendance/current; the frontend reads it on mount, so reload persistence is reliable. The clock-in correctly returns 400 when no schedule is assigned (admin@empresa.com which lacks employee_id). Devices config is a singleton initialized on first GET with panel_web_enabled=true.
